description: In front of you are toy sandwich parts on a bed: two bread slices, a green plate, and flat pieces that look like cheese, onion rings, lettuce, cucumber slices, tomato, and a brown patty. The left hand slides one bread slice onto the green plate, then places the yellow cheese and pink onion ring on top; next the right hand adds the green lettuce, stacks on the cucumber slices, and sets the red tomato slice, then the left hand brings the brown patty over the stack while the right hand lifts and places the second bread slice on top, with both hands pressing down to finish the sandwich.
